the structure and nature of associations between colors and vowels are shared across many participants, even if the specific mappings vary across participants.

the association between color and vowel sounds is structured in a predictable way across individuals, even if the precise mapping varies; that there are subpopulations of participants with atypical mappings; and that mapping consistency and isomorphism are related in several novel ways.
